features: Mensa panel renders immediately after its lazily loaded module becomes available, without awaiting seed vault persistence or encrypted journal network sync
Mensa seed initialization and optional journal sync run after the first Mensa paint; no startup work is added to Today
Failed or stalled dynamic imports display a retryable error instead of an indefinite loading placeholder; module fetch capped at twelve seconds
Mensa module loads only when the Mensa subtab is actually selected, not on normal Nutrition or Today navigation
preservation: No food data, catalog IDs, diary entries, task deadlines, encrypted vault data or personal journal data are migrated or removed.
viteBuildReason: Vite is not locally installed. Production bundling must be confirmed via GitHub Actions.
